# teams_ai_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing AIPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enroll_face` (String) Maps to the -EnrollFace parameter.
- `enroll_voice` (String) Maps to the -EnrollVoice parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `passive_voice_enrollment` (String) Maps to the -PassiveVoiceEnrollment parameter.
- `speaker_attribution_for_byod` (String) Maps to the -SpeakerAttributionForBYOD parameter.
